text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Sprinters Stakes. Cheering 
on her beloved Daiichi Ruby and K.S. 
Miracle with all her heart—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First place goes to Daiichi Ruby. K.S. 
Miracle... unable to cross the finish 
line, is carried away on a stretcher.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The newspapers quietly reported the facts. 
"K.S.Miracle's Career Cut Short" "Race 
Return Hopeless"—or so they wrote.
